id: Batman v Superman: Dawn of Justice (2016)

facts.text: An evening with Lex Luthor. Martha's peach tea. Lex's jar.
facts.why: The jar is labelled Granny's Peach Tea. Martha is Clark Kent's mother and has nothing to do with the tea.
facts.fix: An evening with Lex Luthor. Granny's peach tea. Lex's jar.

facts.text: Bruce slipping out with the drive.
facts.why: Bruce does not leave with the drive. Diana Prince takes it first at the gala, says she only borrowed it, and returns it to him.
facts.fix: Bruce chasing the drive Diana borrowed.

facts.text: Serve the drinks when Lex hands over the jar of peach tea at the hearing.
facts.why: The fandom wiki says Finch notices the jar of Granny's Peach Tea sitting on her desk during the Capitol hearing. Nothing I could open shows Lex handing it over. Finch's 'bucket of piss' line is from an earlier meeting with Lex.
facts.fix: Serve the drinks when Finch finds Lex's jar of peach tea on her desk at the hearing.

facts.why: The gala in the film is Lex's at LexCorp, which the menu itself names elsewhere. A Wayne gala is not in the sources.

vibe.verdict: The jar and the gala are the right ideas, but it is a pale ivory banquet for a dark, grim film and the best lines are missing.
missing: Martha! Why did you say that name? (Batman and Superman fight)
Granny's Peach Tea jar and Finch's bucket line
Diana saying she borrowed the drive and left it in the glove box
Batman's armoured suit and the Bat-Signal
Doomsday impaled on the kryptonite spear
ideas: Swap 'Martha Kent's corn fritters' note for 'Why did you say that name?', with the fritters split in two for the Martha moment.
Swap the tagline 'Martha's peach tea' for 'Granny's peach tea. Not for drinking'.
Swap 'Wayne gala chocolate soufflé' note for 'Diana borrowed the drive and left the pudding'.
Swap the ivory page for a dark slate and red banner so it reads as the film.
